_doc: Channel classification master for MT reporting. Business rule: Total Modern Trade = geographic MT zones + eB2B sub-channel + SIS sub-channel. Zone-level figures (by_zone) carry geographic MT accounts only — eB2B and SIS are excluded from the zone rollup so the zone conversion benchmark is internally comparable. eB2B and SIS are reported on their own pages within the MT deck; they count in all national MT totals.

EB2B.label: eB2B sub-channel
EB2B.note: MT digital sub-channel. Nykaa (FSN) + Eremedium. Excluded from geographic zone rollup so the zone conversion benchmark is internally comparable; counted in all national MT totals. Replaces the former 'Pan India' zone, which was this channel's largest account carried as a seventh geography.

SIS.label: SIS sub-channel
SIS.note: MT shop-in-shop sub-channel. Azorte, Shoppers Stop, Broadway, Lifestyle. Excluded from geographic zone rollup; counted in all national MT totals. Primary is net of MRN returns.

decisions.decision: Exclude the whole Nykaa (FSN) account from Modern Trade geographic zones and report it under eB2B sub-channel.
decisions.accepted_consequence: The account combines FSN (B2C marketplace) with Nykaa SS (eB2B) at article level and the feed cannot separate them, so B2C e-commerce is reported inside eB2B until split feeds are supplied.

decisions.decision: Rename the 'Pan India' zone to 'eB2B' and report it as a channel, not a geography.
Report SIS as its own channel on the same basis as eB2B.

Reclassify eB2B and SIS as MT sub-channels. They are part of total MT and count in all national MT figures (primary ₹49.21 Cr, offtake ₹36.10 Cr). They remain excluded from the geographic zone rollup and conversion benchmark because blending them in would make the benchmark non-comparable across zones.
